reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in your DM thread with what I found on both Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) issues, using only sources Hollis can see.

- **Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts, ticket #PD-4492:** Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers arriving for the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting their bay-assignment texts when they checked in. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct got through the gate without manual help. A follow-up said to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window; I can't tell whether that happened.
- **Door 14 barcode scanners, ticket #4419:** Thea logged this because the scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing, and I found no resolution after that.
- **Ticket number to check:** A July 2025 note from Marcus lists #4419 as a printer delay at Gate 3, not the scanner problem. I asked Hollis to confirm the right number before it goes in the file.

I also warned Hollis not to confuse QFL with Quarendon Freightways, a different carrier that isn't our customer. Hollis isn't in the North team channels or the QFL incident room, so I didn't read them. I pointed Hollis to Dana Okafor or Ilse Varga for anything more recent.

The #PD-4492 details come from a note by Moss that the knowledge base marks as public. That note doesn't appear in the shared file listing, so I couldn't open the original file.
